bfm_followup: a conditional Bernoulli-transition experiment is justified only if the disposition is BINARY_OBSERVER_FEASIBLE and a USEFUL perf-PASS encoder also passes S4 with mean per-bit entropy >= 0.5 bit and <= 10% constant bits
disposition: MECHANICS_BLOCKED if any M gate fails; else BINARY_OBSERVER_NOT_USEFUL if no encoder is USEFUL; else PERFORMANCE_NONPASS if every USEFUL encoder is perf NONPASS; else INCONCLUSIVE if no USEFUL encoder is perf PASS; else BINARY_OBSERVER_FEASIBLE

gates.M1_repeatability: every observed record: encoded twice in process, bitwise identical; native == pure-Python reference bitwise; the first QUAL world re-encoded in a clean process, bitwise identical
gates.M2_non_interference: every QUAL world run with the observer OFF and ON: identical answers (bytes), digests, retained-state snapshots at every state, and K1 counters (forward, learn, commits, refusals, heap allocations)
gates.M3_refusal: the native mechanics test (ctest research.test_ebo_r0) and the Python refusal tests pass: pinned codes, no record written, inputs unchanged; an observation failure leaves the query result intact
gates.M4_fixed_bounded: every record is 64 bytes and admitted by ebo_record_check; rows > 64 are TRUNCATED; the encoder reads only the window (native test)
gates.M5_no_io_alloc: the observer library imports no symbol outside {memcpy, memset, __stack_chk_fail} and weak runtime symbols; ebo_encode / ebo_ring_push / ebo_ring_pop call nothing but the stack-protector failure path; zero allocations across QUERY + encode + push (native test)
gates.M6_no_learn_continuity: the observer library imports no ECS/runtime symbol; observer.py imports no elpis module
gates.M7_handoff: fixed-capacity SPSC ring, DROP_NEWEST, never blocks; FIFO and loss accounting under threads (native test, TSan in CI)
gates.S1_equivalence: per encoder over QUAL states vs the neuron-permuted copy W[:, pi]: digest prefixes differ in 100% of states (identity separates), and payloads are identical in >= 0.99 of states
gates.S2a_distinction: per encoder over QUAL transitions t -> t+1: payload differs in >= 0.95 of transitions
gates.S2b_graded: per encoder over within-world QUAL state pairs: Spearman rho(payload Hamming, L2 of f on X_HELD) >= 0.6, and DIGEST rho is within [-0.2, 0.2] (control validity)
gates.S3_state: per encoder: pooled R^2 on QUAL of f(X_HELD) from the record (DESIGN-trained decoder) >= 0.5, and exceeds every control (DIGEST, RANDOM, SHUFFLED, RESET, ROWPERM) by >= 0.25
gates.S4_transition: per encoder: pooled R^2 on QUAL of f_{t+1}(X_HELD) - f_t(X_HELD) from (record_t, record_t+1) >= 0.3, and exceeds every control (DIGEST, RANDOM, SHUFFLED, RESET) by >= 0.2

perf.disclosed: isolated cost relative to the bare forward median (not a gate)
perf.estimator: delta_p99 = p99(ON) - p99(OFF); 95% CI by block bootstrap over 20 consecutive blocks of pairs, 2000 resamples, seed 20261011
perf.rule: per rows: PASS if CI_high <= theta and isolated (encode + push/pop) <= 0.01 * median_OFF; NONPASS if CI_low > theta or isolated > 0.01 * median_OFF; else INCONCLUSIVE. Encoder PASS iff PASS at every rows; NONPASS if any rows NONPASS; else INCONCLUSIVE
perf.workload: K1 dim 6 width 36, GCC Release, rows 1, 16, 64, 256, 4096; OFF = query_identity; ON = query_identity + ebo_encode + ebo_ring_push; pairs interleaved in fixed pseudo-random order; ring drained outside the timed region
